senses.gloss: m. (סָרַךְ; v. סְרַךְ I) band with which the saddle is fastened around the ass’ belly.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:2">Tosef. Sabb. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 5:2">V</cite>), 2 <he>שלא יקשור את המַסְרֵכוֹ</he> (v. ed. Zuck. note) he must not tie his band; <cite ref="Shabbat 53a">Sabb. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא יקשור בו במסרכו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לו מסריכן</he>, read: <he>מַסְרֵיכוֹ</he>); Y. ib. V, 7ᵇ bot. <he>את המסרוכי</he> (read: <he>המַסְרֵיכוֹ</he>).
